_comment: A realistic first draft: the shape someone actually produces before running validate. Every defect here is one the validator must catch by name. Used by the scripts-loop eval; the fixed version is assets/example-findings.json.

findings.title: Delivery cost is hidden until the last step
findings.evidence: Costs revealed late in a flow is a floor violation, and the running total never appears before the final screen

findings.title: Promo field has no label
findings.evidence: a11y_lint reports the input is labeled only by its placeholder, which vanishes on focus

findings.title: Remove buttons have no accessible name
findings.evidence: a11y_lint reports two icon-only buttons whose img carries no alt text

findings.title: Field spacing is off the scale
findings.evidence: craft_lint reports 13px margin-bottom where the scale is 4px based

findings.title: Three type families in one stylesheet
findings.evidence: craft_lint counts Inter, Söhne Breit, and SF Mono against a ceiling of two

findings.title: Radii are not on a scale
findings.evidence: craft_lint counts eight distinct border-radius values across the file

findings.title: Toast animation runs long
findings.evidence: craft_lint reports an 800ms entrance where the set tops out at 500ms

findings.title: Step counter fails contrast
findings.evidence: contrast_check puts #9aa3af on #ffffff at 2.55:1 against a 4.5:1 requirement

findings.title: Ghost button border is invisible
findings.evidence: contrast_check puts the #e4e7ec border at 1.24:1 against a 3:1 UI requirement
